/bin/bash -lc "cat >> config/config_test.go <<'EOF'

func TestTelemetryDefaultsAndEnvironmentOverrides(t *testing.T) {
 cfg, err := Load(\"./testdata/default.yml\")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.True(t, cfg.Meta.TelemetryEnabled)

 t.Setenv(\"FLIPT_META_TELEMETRY_ENABLED\", \"false\")
 t.Setenv(\"FLIPT_META_STATE_DIRECTORY\", t.TempDir())
 cfg, err = Load(\"./testdata/default.yml\")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.False(t, cfg.Meta.TelemetryEnabled)
 assert.Equal(t, os.Getenv(\"FLIPT_META_STATE_DIRECTORY\"), cfg.Meta.StateDirectory)
}
EOF

p='config/config_test.go'
s=open(p).read().replace('\"io/ioutil\"','\"io/ioutil\"\\n \"os\"')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
GOPROXY=off go test ./config -run TestTelemetryDefaultsAndEnvironmentOverrides -count=1"
